answer: The ledge report shows the merge explicitly at each tide. Each collapsed cluster gets one beacon weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 161 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 116 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1674 identities would post 3269 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
